```{r}
# Choose a sensible figure base font size for A4
# (9–11 is typical for manuscripts; 10 is a good default)
BASE_PT <- 10

# ggplot2 geom_text size is in mm, theme text is in pt
PT_TO_MM <- function(pt) pt / 2.845

# One shared theme for consistency across *everything*
BASE_THEME <- theme_pubr(base_size = BASE_PT, base_family = "Times") +
  theme(
    text        = element_text(family = "Times", size = BASE_PT),
    axis.line   = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = BASE_PT),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = BASE_PT),
    legend.title = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = BASE_PT)
  )
```

#-----Feature Plot of genes chosen------
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
t_common <- BASE_THEME +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = BASE_PT, angle = 0),
    legend.justification = "center"
  )

Feature <- FeaturePlot(Tc_8, c("GZMB", "PRDM1", "RUNX3"), order = TRUE, ncol = 4) & scale_color_gradientn(colours = rev(inferno(256)), na.value = "grey80", limits = c(0.5, NA), breaks = c(0,1,2,3,4)) & labs(color = "Expression") & t_common + NoAxes()

svglite("../docs/assets/07-Figure-7/Feature.svg", width = 3.5, height = 4)
Feature
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/07-Figure-7/Feature.svg")
```

#-----Relevance of PRDM1 and RUNX3 to Cytotoxicity------
```{r}
# RUNX3+ PRDM1+  vs  all other cells
DefaultAssay(Tc_8) <- "RNA"
p8 <- subset(Tc_8, PB == "Plaque")

genes <- c("PRDM1", "RUNX3")
thr   <- 0.75

# Use log-normalized data (recommended for thresholding);
# if you truly want scaled values, change slot to "scale.data"
expr <- GetAssayData(Tc_8, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr))
if (!all(genes %in% genes_present)) {
  stop("Missing genes in RNA assay: ", paste(setdiff(genes, genes_present), collapse = ", "))
}

# Expression per cell
prdm1_expr <- expr["PRDM1", ]
runx3_expr <- expr["RUNX3", ]

# Define double-positive cells
dp <- (prdm1_expr > thr) + (runx3_expr > thr)

# Add group to metadata
Tc_8$COI <- ifelse(dp, "RUNX3+PRDM1+", "Other")

# Differential expression: double-positive vs other
Idents(Tc_8) <- "COI"
DP_DEG <- FindAllMarkers(
  Tc_8,
  min.pct = 0.2,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  test.use = "MAST",
  verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Genes to Plot
gene_sets <- list(
  # --- Cytotoxic Effector / NK-like ---
  C = c("GNLY", "GZMB", "GZMH", "PRF1", "KLRD1", "FGFBP2", "NKG7"))

Dot <- seu_gene_sets_dot(
  seu = NULL,
  markers_df = DP_DEG,
  markers_gene_col  = "gene",
  markers_group_col = "cluster",
  markers_lfc_col   = "avg_log2FC",
  markers_padj_col  = "p_val_adj",
  gene_sets = gene_sets,
  group_by = "cluster",
  assay    = NULL,
  use_scaled_for_fill = TRUE,
  show_missing = TRUE,
  size_range   = c(1, 5),
  size_breaks  = c(5, 25, 50),
  size_limits  = c(0, 50),
  fill_limits  = c(-0.75, 0.75),
  fill_palette = viridisLite::viridis(3),
  x_label      = "",
  x_angle      = 45,
  x_text_size  = BASE_PT,
  y_text_size  = BASE_PT,
  x_title_size = BASE_PT,
  bracket_text_size = 7.5,
  bracket_tick = 0.25,
  y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
  y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
  y_bracket_offset    = 0.40,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
  y_label_offset      = 0,
  plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
  cluster_groups = TRUE,
  cluster_genes  = "within_group",
  dist_method    = "euclidean",
  hclust_method  = "complete"
)  + ggplot2::theme(text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Times")) + coord_flip() 

svglite("../docs/assets/07-Figure-7/Dot_small.svg", width = 4, height = 3)
Dot
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/07-Figure-7/Dot_small.svg")
```

#-----In-house Single Cell GSS Violin------
## All T
```{r}
Tcp <- subset(Tc, PB == "Plaque")
Tcp$Tissue <- factor(Tcp$Tissue, levels = c("Stable", "Unstable"))
set <- list(CytoGMS = c("CD8B", "PRDM1", "RUNX3", "GZMB"))
Tcp <- UCell::AddModuleScore_UCell(Tcp, features = set, w_neg = 1, maxRank = 2000)

Idents(Tcp) <- "Tissue"
cytoGMS_sc <- VlnPlot(Tcp, c("CytoGMS_UCell"), fill.by = "ident", cols = c("#00C7CC", "#FA7F74"), pt.size = 0, adjust = 1) + geom_boxplot(width=0.1) + NoLegend() + ylab(expression(CD8^{CytoGSS}~"UCell Score")) + 
BASE_THEME + 
theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      aspect.ratio = 2) + 
NoLegend() + labs(
  title = expression(atop(
    CD8^"CytoGSS" ~ "& plaque instability",
    "(in-house T cell scRNA)"
  )))

svglite("../docs/assets/07-Figure-7/CytoGMS_sc.svg", width = 3.5, height = 4)
cytoGMS_sc
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/07-Figure-7/CytoGMS_sc.svg")
```
